answer_1.quote: This facilitates various applications using LVLMs such as autonomous driving , image creation ... and medical assistants .
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated responses in open-ended and multimodal question-answering tasks, where models generate natural language answers conditioned on images and text inputs.

answer_2.quote: LLaVABench  uses GPT-4 to compare generated answers with reference answers.

answer_3.quote: We employ GPT-4 as the evaluator to compare the model's generated answers with reference answers, ensuring a comprehensive assessment of the model's generative performance.

answer_4.quote: We invited three human participants (all of them are Ph.D. students or Master students) to compare the responses generated by the models.
answer_4.guideline: Principles of Human Evaluation for LLaVABench: 1. Correctness: Assess whether responses address the key points outlined in the reference answer and image. 2. Faithfulness: Examine any additional information in the answer to verify its accuracy and relevance. 3. Coherence: Evaluate the fluency and coherence of the responses.
